notes: Coverage: the whole image was viewed once for layout, then half_a and half_b once each in order. Every visible word and ending, accent, abbreviation, punctuation mark, insertion, deletion, and every inline mathematical expression was compared against both C and H. There are no displayed formula blocks, diagrams, drawings, standalone marginal notes, headings, dates, or author page numbers on this page. The archive footer 10 is separate from the main pen text.

The page is wholly handwritten. The packet does not independently identify the hand, so no personal attribution is made. Faint reverse-side show-through was not promoted into text. Returning g descenders were distinguished from deliberate underlines; no source underlining is asserted here.

Ten tight crops were generated from the whole-source pixel coordinates and each was viewed once: c01–c03, then c04–c06, then c07–c08, then c09–c10. No whole image or half was reopened for visual inspection, no whole half was enlarged, and no settled locus was recropped. c06 addresses a suspected internal-spelling disagreement left open by the half and resolves it in favour of both witnesses. The s’obtient en insertion connector in c04 is accounted for as an insertion hook, not a separate drawing.

Half-settled locator metadata is included in scan_shows for every difference without a reader crop. All those boxes use the original 1130×1738 whole-source coordinate system. The supplied halves are 1130×949; half_b corresponds to the lower portion with a nominal y offset of 789. The main reader must personally adjudicate every difference against either witness using the retained crops or its own adjudication crop of the stated box.

For the final formula c09 distinguishes two physical marks: a low pale curved trace after the complete closing parentheses, and a high dark edge point. C’s comma/full-stop alternative collapses these heights. The reading retains the lower comma with a nontextual alternative and positions the separately uncertain high point above it. The phantom alternatives concern textual status and do not deny the visible marks.

The writer says Je sais prouver (sauf erreur) that every indicated homomorphism comes from a suitable Picard champ, gives Ext^3(X;M,N) as the a priori obstruction location, and says a universel argument makes it zero. These are statements encountered on the page; no proof of them was supplied or independently performed in this run.

The writer describes the extension alpha, with a visible comma after alpha, as close to split: tte section of the third sheaf over any object of X se remonte. He then says there is better and that a section over U in Ob X comes from the written degree-two hypercohomology group. The source’s qualification sauf erreur and its quoted words are preserved.

C’s initial cotefile wrapper is omitted under the brief’s rule that only the first scan begins with cotefile; this is scope metadata, not a textual reading change. H’s page{10} already records the archive numeral. H’s editorial statement about another dossier is not source ink on this page and was not used as evidence or transcribed as page text.

Only the assigned packet, its snapshot, and the assigned scan images were used. No OCR, image-to-text software, PDF text layer, outside source, other scan, other reader return, or delegation was used. No LaTeX compilation was performed. Mathematical checks are empty because no mathematical proof or computation was actually carried out.
